reason: The cited evidence shows that HEAs can be BCS superconductors in the dirty limit (E2) and that a specific HEA exhibits intermediate electron–phonon coupling (E1), but neither passage provides any evidence that annealing-induced local ordering enhances electron–phonon coupling or Tc, nor that the as-cast state lacks superconductivity. The key mechanistic premises are therefore unsupported by the cited prior work.
premises: Annealing induces partial atomic ordering in the HEA
Enhanced coupling overcomes impurity scattering in the dirty limit
This enables conventional BCS pairing and raises Tc
As-cast disordered state shows weak or no superconductivity
